item.description:

This morning, the U.S. Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, one of Israel’s greatest supporters, referred to the actions of Israelis in the village of Qusra as “terror” – what’s behind this issue?

Here is the full translation of Huckabee’s tweet – and immediately after, the background:

“This is another lie. The U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem was very involved in the matter, and at our request, the IDF and Israeli police arrived at the scene to remove the Israeli terrorists who are doing this.

The acts these people are committing in the family’s home are criminal. The White House did not ‘intervene,’ because we had already updated Washington on the developments.

The actions of those who carried out this shocking act of terror, intended to frighten and harass the family, are repugnant. There is no justification for such bullying behavior.

But the claim that the U.S. Embassy in Israel or the U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem do not care or did nothing about the matter is simply not true.”

In this tweet, Huckabee is responding to Iyad Hassan, a Palestinian-American human rights activist who complains that the U.S. did not intervene after “for five consecutive days, terrorist settlers have been besieging a house in the village of Qusra belonging to a man who holds American citizenship.”

In fact, one of the homeowner’s sons holds American citizenship – this is the background for the U.S. intervention.

Hassan attaches the video presented here to clarify what is being discussed.
##

The village of Qusra (Qasra) is located in the southern Nablus district, part of it in Area B (where Israel has security control but not municipal authority) and part of it in Area C (where Israel has both security and civil – municipal – control).

Is the Democrats party changing its strategy following the recent controversies associated with it? Yesterday, a campaign meeting was held with the party’s candidates.
